hooks.command: $j = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($j.cwd -and ($j.cwd -replace '/', '\') -like '*\.claude\worktrees\*') { $main = Split-Path -Parent ((git -C $j.cwd rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir) -replace '/', '\'); $s = @((Join-Path $main 'scripts\worktree-clean.ps1'), (Join-Path (git -C $j.cwd rev-parse --show-toplevel) 'scripts\worktree-clean.ps1')) | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($s) { Start-Process powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -WorkingDirectory $env:USERPROFILE -ArgumentList '-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',$s,'-Cwd',$j.cwd } }
